441. Prime Count in Range

Problem Statement:
Given Q ranges of the form L R, find the number of numbers X such that X is prime and L <= X <= R.
input_spec:
The first line contains an integer Q.
The next Q lines contain two space separated integers L and R.
output_spec: Print Q lines answering each query.
